name: Jenni
style: American Traditional · Fine Line · Watercolor Flash
bio: Jenni, an experienced tattoo artist with more than ten years in the field, started the shop in 2021.
She enjoys various tattoo styles, especially American traditional.
While she mostly works by appointment, she accepts walk-ins when possible, reserving Saturdays for them and flash tattoos.
Jenni also has a keen interest in tattoo history, reflected in her collection of tattoo books, memorabilia and vintage flash.
She enjoys creating and painting watercolor flash as a form of artistic expression.

name: Cory
bio: Cory, a tattoo artist with 20 years of experience, joined I Love You Tattoo in April 2022.
He specializes in colorful illustrations and is versatile in different styles.
His main thing is creating cute, vibrant tattoos that last.
In his free time, he enjoys drawing with colored pencils, paint markers, and spray paint.
He has a lifelong passion for comics and cartoons and collects comics and action figures.
Cory's commitment to his craft is evident in every tattoo he does, making him a valuable team member.

name: Skylar
bio: Skylar joined us in September 2022 and has ten years of tattooing experience.
He has developed two distinct styles: void tattooing, which focuses on black work, and tattoos inspired by nature and sci-fi, featuring bright colors and decaying elements.
He mainly works by appointment but occasionally accepts walk-ins for his flash designs.
Outside of tattooing, Skylar enjoys building terrariums, making jewelry, and exploring various crafts.
Working with him is both a professional and personal pleasure due to his enthusiasm and friendly nature.

name: Millie
bio: Millie, a talented tattoo artist with 9 years of experience, joined our team in August of 2023.
Specializing in pointillism black work, she also enjoys exploring color and portraits in her art. Her tattoos are known for their soft, beautiful aesthetic.
Working by appointment only, Millie opens her books for bookings every quarter.
Outside of her tattooing work, she finds joy in hiking, tending to her plant collection, and baking sourdough bread.
With her calming presence, great taste in music, and relaxed demeanor, spending time with Millie at the shop is always a pleasure.

name: Gia
bio: Gia, our talented tattoo artist, has been sharing her artistry with us for four wonderful years, having become a part of our team in April of 2023.
Her passion for tattooing shines through especially when creating designs of flowers and animals.
Beyond her tattooing expertise, Gia finds joy in collecting quirky knick-knacks and fascinating flash pieces.
Aiming to evolve further as an artist, she embraces various styles with enthusiasm.
Known for her gentle and kind nature, Gia brings a sweet presence to the studio, making every session a delightful experience.
Whether scheduling appointments or welcoming walk-ins, Gia's dedication to her craft always shines through.

name: Remy
bio: Remy is a skilled tattoo artist with three years of experience and a total of four years in the industry.
He joined our team in October 2024 and works by appointment only, giving each client his full attention.
He enjoys creating bold, colorful anime tattoos and traditional designs, showcasing his artistic talent.
In his free time, Remy likes playing video games, drawing, watching anime, and reading manga.
Remy is a friendly and fun person who takes his work seriously. You won't regret choosing him as your tattoo artist.

name: Eathan
bio: Eathan is the enthusiastic and dedicated apprentice over at our tattoo studio, honing his skills every day.
Eathan enjoys a challenge himself with his drawing, as well as commissions he receives.
He always brings cheer to the shop, with his infectious laughter and sense of humor.
Recently, he began tattooing on skin under guidance, and he is excited to proceed with the career of his dreams.
If you would like to get tattooed by Eathan, please keep in mind that he is still in the learning phase and the tattoos he offers are considered apprentice level.
However, every opportunity he gets to improve, he wholeheartedly embraces, eager to grow and develop his craft.

name: Zoie
bio: Zoie, our newest apprentice, is new to the art of tattooing, but she brings with her over seven years of invaluable experience in the industry.
She officially joined our dedicated team in February 2024.
Zoie is diligently working her way toward becoming our shop's tiny tattoo specialist, with a focus on creating precise, beautiful designs.
Her commitment is evident as she works hard to learn and perfect her skills in tiny tattooing.
We invite you to book a session with her today and become a part of her exciting artistic journey.
